'''Mili''' is a [[Loloish languages|Loloish]] language spoken in [[Jingdong Yi Autonomous County|Jingdong County]] (in Anding 安定乡 and Wenlong 文龙乡 townships<ref name="AsiaHarvest">{{Cite web |title=China |url=http://asiaharvest.org/index.php/people-group-profiles/china/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130801062653/http://asiaharvest.org/index.php/people-group-profiles/china/ |archive-date=2013-08-01 |access-date=2013-07-19 |website=Asia Harvest}}</ref>), [[Yun County, Yunnan|Yun]], [[Zhenyuan Yi, Hani and Lahu Autonomous County|Zhenyuan]], and [[Xinping Yi and Dai Autonomous County|Xinping]] counties of [[Yunnan]] province, China. Mili is a variety of [[Lolopo language|Lolopo]].<ref name="Yang2011">Yang, Cathryn. 2011. ''Assessment of the Lolo languages: Current understanding and recommended next steps''. m.s.</ref>
